newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 1.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average rose 9.25 points to 5,882.17 on Monday.
** Indonesia has offered tax incentives for importers of goods which are to be re-exported within 12 months. The incentives are effective from October 1.
** The Jakarta composite index inched up 0.11 percent, or 0.64 points, to close at 573.94 points on Monday with the focus still on automotive giant PT Astra International.
** On Tuesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,323.75/24.75 in early trading against an opening of 2,323.50/25.00.
** Astra on news that Indonesian tobacco tycoon Putera Sampoerna has confirmed he had bought a 9.81 percent stake in the automobile conglomerate.
** Sinar Mas Multiartha on reports the firm planned to announce a 500 billion rupiah rights issue.
** Cable companies Jembo Cable and Kabelindo Murni on market talk of possible poor earnings due to slow demand from state-owned electricity firm PLN.
** Industrial estate firm Jababeka on reports the government has temporarily suspended giving new approvals for industrial estates in West Java.
